# Ayati Group

> Ayati Group is a residential developer building independent-floor homes and low-density apartments in Noida and Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India. Four developments are listed on the site: Aadya Homes and Aadya Residency in Sector 73, Noida, and Ayati Greens 1 and Ayati Greens 2 on Dadri Surajpur Road, Greater Noida.

Address: A-243, Sector 43, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301, India.
Phone: +91 99535 33766, +91 98717 96816. Email: ayatidevelopers@gmail.com.

Terms as the site states them: the booking agreement documents the full price before you sign, with no additional charges at possession, no floor-rise fees and no hidden amenity costs; payment is linked to construction milestones and the full structure is shared in writing at a first meeting; eight lenders have approved Ayati Group projects for home loans (ICICI Bank, Bajaj Finserv, Piramal Finance, Aditya Birla Capital, Aavas, GIC Housing Finance, Adhaar Housing Finance and SMFG India Credit); buyers can walk the construction site before deciding. Prices, floor areas and possession dates are not published on the website. The site says they are shared in writing at a first meeting.

## Developments

- [Aadya Homes](https://ayatigroup.com/#aadya-homes): 3 BHK independent floors in Sector 73, Noida.
- [Aadya Residency](https://ayatigroup.com/#aadya-residency): 3 BHK homes in Sector 73, Noida, two homes per floor.
- [Ayati Greens 1](https://ayatigroup.com/#ayati-greens-1): 2 and 3 BHK homes on Dadri Surajpur Road, Greater Noida, three homes per floor.
- [Ayati Greens 2](https://ayatigroup.com/#ayati-greens-2): the next phase of the Ayati Greens community on Dadri Surajpur Road, Greater Noida. Low-density apartments. Floor plans and pricing are not yet announced.

## Site

- [Homepage](https://ayatigroup.com/): who Ayati Group is, the four developments, the approved lenders, and how to book a site visit.
- [Homebuyer insights](https://ayatigroup.com/blog/): practical guides for buyers in Noida and Greater Noida.
- [Careers](https://ayatigroup.com/careers/): two work-from-home internships, Graphic Design Intern and Marketing Intern, ₹10,000 per month.

## Insights

- [The Strategic Advantage of Living in Central Noida: Sectors 73 & 75](https://ayatigroup.com/blog/central-noida-sectors-73-75.html): expressway access, proximity to IT parks and schools in Sectors 73 and 75.
- [Why Independent Floors Are the Future of Comfortable Living in Noida](https://ayatigroup.com/blog/why-independent-floors-noida.html): how an independent floor compares with an apartment on privacy, space and ownership.
- [Why Vastu-Compliant Homes Are a Must for Indian Families](https://ayatigroup.com/blog/vastu-compliant-homes-india.html): how Vastu principles shape light, ventilation and room orientation in Ayati floor plans.
